name: Tm Docs Reader
pitch: The docs of your installed Tallmaker extensions, inside the app: an index, contents, pages and search. Free.
question: How do I use this Tallmaker extension, in the version we run?
questions: Which Tallmaker extensions are installed, and which docs version do they ship?
Where is the setting that changes this chart?
Can a demo app carry the help for its own extension?
useWhen: Help for installed Tallmaker extensions, inside Qlik.
audience: App authors and users of Tallmaker extensions who want help next to the sheet.
features: Lists installed Tallmaker products with docs
Docs always match the installed version
Contents, pages and search across products
Lock to one product for a help sheet

hero.alt: The reader with the product tree on the left and the installed Tallmaker products with their docs versions on the right.
hero.caption: The installed Tallmaker products and their docs versions

screenshots.alt: The Getting started page of Tm Docs Reader, open on the right with the product tree on the left.
screenshots.caption: Read the guide with the index always in view

screenshots.alt: The When to use page of Tm Docs Reader listing good and poor fits, with an On this page list.
screenshots.caption: Pages say when an extension is a good fit

featureStrips.heading: Docs that match the installed version
featureStrips.text: Each extension ships its docs inside its own zip, so the reader shows the docs of the version you run. No archive, no drift.
featureStrips.alt: The Overview page of Tm Docs Reader with the badge Docs for version 0.1.1.

featureStrips.heading: The index stays open beside the text
featureStrips.text: Pick a product and a page in the tree on the left. The text opens on the right, with On this page links and Previous and Next.
featureStrips.alt: The Settings page open on the right, with the tree of products and pages on the left.

featureStrips.heading: Search across every installed product
featureStrips.text: Type a word to find the pages that hold it, in every product with docs, or only in the product you locked the reader to.
featureStrips.alt: Search results for tooltip listing pages from several products, with their snippets.
